items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with her until she was in her nineties.

ctx.x: Yeah. She wrote it in the book. I was with her until she was in her nineties. She’s an incredible human being, Romanian and French, and a little Russian, I think, too. She would always book me last at Fountainbleu in the summer.
So she could spent time with you.
